effectSummary.en: Using Guardian's Vow during Breath Before Battle immediately grants and consumes its remaining fixed restoration. Add 0.25% maximum HP to Vow's barrier per resource actually restored, capped at 8%; 8s interval.

description.ko: 최대 HP 12% 보호막을 5초간 얻고 현재 걸린 둔화·속박을 제거합니다. 이후 2초간 둔화·속박에 면역입니다. 철벽 시전으로 처리하지 않습니다.
description.en: Gain a 12% maximum-HP barrier for 5s and remove current slow and root effects. Become immune to slow and root for 2s. This does not cast Iron Wall.

concept: One finger ring with a tall shield-like hollow bezel wrapping a steady warm amber core, two interlocking silver breath-shaped ribs forming a continuous protective arch. Worn iron base and open center. Calm stored resolve, no vapor.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: DES_LW45, Unspent Resolve, class Warrior, slot finger ring.
Subject design: One finger ring with a tall shield-like hollow bezel wrapping a steady warm amber core, two interlocking silver breath-shaped ribs forming a continuous protective arch. Worn iron base and open center. Calm stored resolve, no vapor.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: Using Guardian's Vow during Breath Before Battle immediately grants and consumes its remaining fixed restoration. Add 0.25% maximum HP to Vow's barrier per resource actually restored, capped at 8%; 8s interval.
Direct skill context: W15 Breath Before Battle — Restore 8 resource each second for 4s, up to the resource cap. Attacks and movement remain available. This is not a Shout.; W16 Guardian's Vow — Gain a 12% maximum-HP barrier for 5s and remove current slow and root effects. Become immune to slow and root for 2s. This does not cast Iron Wall.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: square native PNG with real transparent alpha; the built-in 1254 by 1254 output is accepted, and 1024 by 1024 is also accepted. Preserve native pixels and alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. Aim to contain the entire subject, including all tips and chain, within the central 76% with generous transparent padding. No part may be clipped or missing. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
